title: The Impossibility of Fair LLMs
findings: The paper reviews and cites existing literature to support its claims, noting that LLMs exhibit biases related to religion. Specifically, it references findings that models tend to associate Muslims with violence and display disparities in sentiment and toxicity based on the religious identity of a subject. Religion is used as an example of a sensitive attribute that makes achieving formal fairness intractable.

measurement_description: The paper cites studies measuring association-based biases, such as the tendency to generate violent words following prompts mentioning Muslims, and disparities in sentiment and toxicity based on religion in sentence completions. It also discusses religion as a sensitive attribute in recommendation tasks.
